Q1: Which branch should the fix PR target?
Choices:
A) PR #7012's head branch `claude/elegant-mendel-5pli2i-merge-safety`. The fix PR stacks on it and edits only `tests/test_ci_job_split_contract.py`. Merging it pushes to #7012 and re-runs its CI against the real `budget-watch` job. (RECOMMENDED)
B) The default branch `main`. The explicit `budget-watch` exception lands ahead of the job. It does nothing until #7012 merges, and #7012 needs a new push to re-run CI. If #7012 also edits this test file, the two may conflict.
C) Neither. First check whether #7012's current head `753af619` already fixes the test. The triage context was for `29c27240`, a different SHA, so this is unconfirmed. If the head is already fixed, close this issue as not needed.
